rationale: Consolidated NJT page of the MNB payment-execution decree; each amendment carries hard compliance dates — core A3 payments signal.
MNB Act consolidated text defines which supervisory instruments bind; durable interpretive anchor for the compliance calendar.
Issuer's own chronological MNB rendelet index — structured, continuously producing detection surface for new decrees.
MNB payments regulation hub carries issuer commentary and forthcoming-amendment notices not visible from the decree index alone.
Free consolidated law-in-force database with stable deep links; cross-check against NJT flags contested or recent amendments.
Parliament-facing statute collection for lineage tracing of amended/superseded financial-sector acts.
Bill tracker gives the earliest hard signal of statutory deadlines, weeks before gazette promulgation.
Single session-specific programme document rather than a feed; valuable forward calendar evidence, re-fetched per session.
Ministry draft-decree consultation repository with stated comment deadlines — directly on-topic for consultations and deadlines.
Separate consultation portal; drafts are not mirrored to the Dokumentumtár, so it must be monitored in parallel.
State legal-information portal aggregating current gazette issues; redundancy path if magyarkozlony.hu is unavailable.
Weekly professional gazette digest; strong triage layer that reduces false negatives from keyword-only scraping.
Scrapeable third-party bill mirror, but provenance and maintenance cadence unverified — redundant to parlament.hu.
AI-generated gazette summaries with self-declared non-authoritative status; too low-credibility for any date or obligation.
EUR-Lex NIM register is the weekly-updated join between EU transposition deadlines and Hungarian act numbers.
N-Lex info page is a static gateway description under europa.eu; useful once for crawler design, not a signal producer.
Publisher/webshop site useful once for provenance, licensing and back-issue access; liveness needs the browser recheck.
Commercial historical gazette archive behind subscription; mine only for retrospective lineage work once access is cleared.
Payments vendor newsroom is often the only public trace of Hungarian bank card/acquiring procurement driven by compliance.
One-off customer case study citing MNB requirements as buying driver; strong evidence but a static page, not a feed.
Core-banking vendor newsroom that surfaced the MBH Vault Core selection; recurring source of Hungarian core-banking signals.
Hungarian vendor news/case-study feed naming bank clients and migration timetables; failed verification is soft, browser pass to confirm.
Hungarian-language transformation consultancy blog revealing which core platforms Hungarian banks shortlist and why.
Domestic banking software vendor reference page; rare Hungarian-language listing of named bank clients and modules.
Largest Hungarian SI with banking reporting services and listed-issuer announcements revealing financial-sector contract wins.
Annual bank-IT conference sponsor/speaker/agenda pages enumerate the Hungarian supplier landscape and the regulations driving spend.
Hungarian IT trade press often first to publish vendor-bank engagements and links them explicitly to DORA/regulatory drivers.
